vcRuntime.note: nth installer PLAN.md override 4 and section 9 item 2 (ED-NEW-inst-u7-3): the four Visual C++ runtime DLLs the voice natives import, copied next to nth.exe from Visual Studio's redistributable folder (VC\Redist\MSVC\<redistVersion>\x64\Microsoft.VC14?.CRT and Microsoft.VC14?.OpenMP) instead of Velopack's vcredist143-x64 prerequisite. Windows does not service these copies, so every release build compares the pin with the newest redistributable installed and stops when the pin is older than securityFloor.

securityFloor.source: https://learn.microsoft.com/cpp/windows/latest-supported-vc-redist (the page lists no number; the file version of https://aka.ms/vc14/vc_redist.x64.exe is the newest). Raise this, and the pin below, whenever Microsoft ships a newer v14 runtime with a security fix. Set on 2026-10-11 from the newest redistributable installed on the build PC (Visual Studio Build Tools 2026 18.5); it was not compared with Microsoft's latest download, which needs a network check by the lead.
